compensationBridge.futureExpensePolicy: Use FY2025 gross grant-value/revenue ratio1.00947% as the future economic grant-cost budget, with no forfeiture credit. Hold this ratio in all annual rows and terminal margins. No future dilution is then added separately. Stress the ratio rather than forgetting the cost.
compensationBridge.FY2026Normalization: Management-derived EBIT18565.8 includes amortized reported compensation. Estimate that total as9M162.8 times4/3=217.0667, remove it and substitute the economic future-grant budget. This decreases rather than raises economic EBIT. Residual operating costs stay fixed. The Q4 reported-compensation estimate is not a published guidance item.
compensationBridge.laterYearPolicy: Starting with v2 normalized margins and the FY2025amortized SBC/revenue baseline0.619274%, reduce each2027-2035margin and terminal margin by economic-grant ratio minus that baseline. Residual non-SBC operating cost ratios including D&A are therefore held fixed; no unexplained cost recalibration preserves the old margin. The legacy schedule is synthetically deducted and reversed identically, with no uplift above the resulting economic margin.
compensationBridge.legacyTimingAssumption: For reconciliation only, allocate215 over1.4years:153.5714 in2026 and61.4286 in2027. Because deduction and reversal are equal within each year, this timing assumption creates no operating value. The matching old awards are allocated separately using the disclosed-count proxy.
compensationBridge.optionPolicy: Old options are fully vested. No legacy expense is reversed for them. Full-share allocation with zero exercise credit conservatively overstates their claim relative to an intrinsic allocation; it is not claimed to be Black-Scholes fair value.
compensationBridge.ESPPPolicy: Employee stock purchase plan retention bonus stays a cash personnel cost in residual operating costs. It is not removed, put into this LTI grant budget, or assigned separate future dilution.
compensationBridge.taxPolicy: Apply selected cash-tax rate to economic EBIT. No extra vesting tax windfall asset is added. Opening tax assets/liabilities have a separate explicit capital policy.

customerAdvancePolicy.basePolicy: Hold the total opening customer-advance balance constant in nominal EUR throughout the explicit forecast. As advances are released against delivered tools/services, an equal amount of new advance receipts from new orders replaces them. Therefore delta advances=0, not a positive growth cash-flow contribution. Positive15%incremental noncash working-capital investment is measured excluding any assumed advance-growth credit.
customerAdvancePolicy.whyNeeded: Reported revenue on previously prepaid sales is not fresh cash collection. The constant-balance assumption explicitly supplies replacement advances from new orders; it is not receipt of the same customer payment twice. If replacement orders or customer deposits weaken, FCFF must absorb net advance runoff.
customerAdvancePolicy.terminalPolicy: The terminal10%NOPAT reinvestment requirement covers total net operating capital. No additional terminal advance-growth cash windfall is added.

exampleAnnualGrossFlow.classification: Illustration using2025actual release amount, not a forecast of2026release timing

customerAdvancePolicy.replenishmentRisk: Constant nominal advances become smaller relative to growing revenue; still, maintaining them depends on customer orders, delivery timing, export permissions and contractual deposits. The excess-cash allocation is conditional on this funding policy.
customerAdvancePolicy.cashReservePolicy: Subtract3bn analyst operating-liquidity reserve from reported cash before allocation. It is not a substitute for modelling advance runoff and does not imply all remaining cash is unrestricted surplus in every scenario.

advanceRunoffStress.policy: No replacement for selected share of opening advances; net runoff is additional working-capital investment, never a second debt claim. Remaining balance is held constant. Annual revenue/margins are otherwise unchanged, so this isolates financing dependency rather than a full downturn.
